question_text:
Three engineers P, Q, R are designing a project. Can we find out in how much time all the
three engineers will complete the designing, observing the following statements?
I.
P & Q can complete the design in 2 months
II.
Q & R can complete the design in 1½ months
III.
P & R can complete the design in 3 months.
P, Q, R 

I.
P Q 
II.
Q R 
III.
P  R 

Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting on the corners (vertices) of a Hexagon shaped table, all
facing towards centre. ‘A’ sits between F and C. D is on the second right of B and is the immediate
neighbour of C.
